subject: História
description_pt: Discutir as razões da passagem do mercantilismo para o capitalismo.

components.description_pt: Identificar características econômicas-chave que definem o mercantilismo como sistema
components.description_en: Identify the key economic characteristics that define mercantilism as a system
components.cc_component_description: Identify the key steps in a historical or social studies process described in a text

components.description_pt: Explicar fatores sociais e econômicos que impulsionaram o declínio das práticas mercantilistas
components.description_en: Explain the social and economic factors that drove the decline of mercantilist practices

components.description_pt: Analisar o papel da expansão comercial e burguesia emergente na ascensão do capitalismo
components.description_en: Analyze the role of commercial expansion and emerging bourgeoisie in the rise of capitalism

components.description_pt: Comparar modelos econômicos mercantilista e capitalista em termos de comércio, trabalho e controle estatal
components.description_en: Compare mercantilist and capitalist economic models in terms of trade, labor, and state control

cc_matches.description: Identify key steps in a text's description of a process related to history/social studies (e.g., how a bill becomes law, how interest rates are raised or lowered).
